sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 - Amazon Bedrock
supports: The model is billed through AWS Marketplace.
The US geographic inference profile ID is us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6.
From us-east-1 the fixed destinations are us-east-1, us-east-2, and us-west-2.

sources.title: Regional availability by models - Amazon Bedrock
supports: Geographic cross-Region inference is priced at the source Region rate with no routing surcharge.

sources.title: Anthropic List Prices - 2026-05-27
supports: Claude Sonnet 4.6 standard US-only inference list prices per million tokens.

qualificationDecision: Use the current US-only standard rates for the approved AWS US geographic route. Conservatively reserve uncached input at the highest input-side rate, 6.60 USD per million tokens, while cache and reasoning remain disabled.
